queries_run: Nucor NUE analyst consensus vs guidance Q4 2026
Nucor earnings guidance fourth quarter 2026 October

findings.claim: Nucor Q3 2026 release (late Oct 2026): management expects Q4 2026 earnings generally in line with or modestly higher than Q3; steel mills stable, steel products flat, raw materials slightly lower. Q3 revenue $11.25B vs consensus $10.79B, adj EPS $5.80 vs $5.83 est; stock rose ~6%.
findings.source: TIKR blog: Nucor soars 6% on Q3 revenue beat, sees Q4 in line with or modestly higher

findings.claim: Q3 2026 guidance issued 2026-09-17 was EPS $5.55-$5.65 (raised from $4.5-$4.6), vs consensus EPS $6.17 at that time (guided below consensus); Q4 2026 EPS consensus ~$5.07-$5.14 on revenue ~$9.75-9.80B per Benzinga snapshots (undated).

Analyst price targets vary by source/date: Bullstory avg $282.81 from 16 analysts as of 2026-08-30 (Buy); Walnut avg $280.31 (16 analysts, Aug 2026); Tickflow avg $253.63 (22 analysts, 2026-07-31); StreetInsider 12-month range high $297 (Wells Fargo) to low $190 (Jefferies), avg $264.90. No snapshot dated after late Aug 2026 found.
findings.source: Bullstory NUE analyst forecast; Tickflow; StreetInsider

findings.claim: Nucor 8-K Q3 2026 earnings release with Q4 outlook
